pretraining.restored_downloader_scope: Bounded 50–200000-row fresh download/cleaning. The historical full token corpus is not bundled; a fresh download is not an exact replay of that corpus.

tokenizer.origin: Reused Python-Edu BPE; hashes match historical pretraining manifest. Original tokenizer fit sample list is not recovered.

bst.origin: Project-owned programmatic BST specifications, reference implementations and tests
bst.design: Each of 17 operations has single-condition variants (all taught) and 31 two-condition combinations split into SFT (11), RL only (10) and never trained (10). test_seen* reuse the taught tasks and tests with an unseen function name, shuffled fields or renamed parameters; test_holdout holds every range specification with 3-4 changed conditions; test_transfer holds eight operations absent from training.
bst.language: Python-style specification fields; Python solutions and pytest suites
